label: copy phase: fed-back input e early in the copy (one of the first ~3 recalled tokens)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and only when the input fed back is the letter e (in_tok == e accounts for 100% of activations). It is limited to early copy steps: e has to be one of original tokens 0-2 (recall_idx 1-3), with at least 2 outputs still to come. Magnitude is largest when e is the first original token, so it is fed back right after <DEL> (recall_idx 1, about 52% of mass; all top examples, max 3.6). It is weaker when e is the second original token (about 40% of mass) and weak or often absent when e is the third (most false positives are here, and in short sequences). Never fires in the original phase, on the delimiter, on any other token, or when e is fed back late in the copy (recall_idx >= 4 is near zero). Nearly all activity is when the model is copying correctly.

issues: Every factual claim checks out on the dev profile. All activation is in the copy phase (0 in the original phase and 0 on the delimiter). in_tok == e holds 100% of activation mass, with 0 activations on any other token. Mass share by recall_idx is 1: 0.524, 2: 0.403, 3: 0.071, and recall_idx >= 4 is about 0.001. Max is 3.61.

False positives are concentrated where the explanation says they are. At recall_idx == 3, precision is 0.45 overall and 0.37 when to_go == 2. In L <= 4 sequences (recall_idx 1, to_go 2), precision is 0.53. Elsewhere precision is 0.80-0.90. This is acknowledged weakness, not a hidden counterexample class.
Misses are tiny: 665 steps on test, 0.3% of mass. They are low-amplitude e inputs at recall_idx >= 4 or to_go < 2. There is no systematic pattern.

Minor point: the label's 'one of the first ~3 recalled tokens' slightly overstates recall_idx 3, which is active less than half the time and carries 7% of mass. In effect the feature is 'e as recall 1 or 2, sometimes 3 when many outputs remain'.
A refinement that drops recall_idx 3 when to_go < 3 raises test F1 only marginally (0.919 -> 0.925, precision 0.864 -> 0.899, mass recall 0.997 -> 0.991). That is not enough to reject the original.
